name: Jellyfin Background Play
description: Quitter le lecteur vidéo web ne coupe plus la vidéo : elle continue en fond avec une mini barre de lecture, comme la musique. Leaving the web video player no longer stops the video: it keeps playing with a mini player bar, just like music.
overview: La vidéo continue en fond quand on quitte le lecteur. Keep videos playing when leaving the player.

versions.changelog:
- Leaving the video player (back arrow, browser back) no longer stops the video: it keeps playing in the background.
- The same mini player bar as for music shows up at the bottom: play/pause, stop, previous/next episode, seek, volume. Click it to get back to the player.
- The next episode starts in the background without bringing the player back.
- New Stop button next to pause in the player, and a close cross at its top right, to stop the video and leave.

name: Jellyfin Player Queue
description: Bouton file de lecture dans le lecteur vidéo web : saison en cours, navigation entre saisons, lecture directe d'un épisode. Play queue button in the web video player: current season, season navigation, click-to-play.
overview: File de lecture / saisons dans le lecteur vidéo. Play queue & seasons in the video player.

versions.changelog:
- Works with Jellyfin Background Play: when the video keeps playing in the mini player bar, the queue button is there too, with the panel right above the bar (shortcut `Q` as well).
- Picking an episode from that panel switches to it without reopening the player.

- Works with SyncPlay: everything you do in the panel applies to the whole group.
- The panel updates by itself when someone else changes the queue.
- "Play next" and "Add to end of queue" now work during a SyncPlay session.

- The panel opens instantly, even for series with many seasons.
- The list no longer reloads or jumps after you add, move or remove an episode.
- Adding a big selection to the pending queue stops as soon as it's full, instead of making you wait.
- "Play all from here" on a season now really starts at that season.

- A message now tells you when the pending queue is full (200 items).
- "Play next" always works, even when the pending queue is full.

- Build a queue without playing anything: "Add to play queue" and "Play next" now work from the library when nothing is playing.
- Episodes, movies, seasons, whole series and collections pile up in a pending queue: review it, remove what you don't want, then play.
- Movies show proper artwork in the list.
- One "⋮" menu per episode (Play next, Add to end of queue, Remove) instead of several buttons.

- Reorder the queue by drag and drop.
- Remove items from the queue.
- "Play next" and "Add to end of queue" on any episode of the season.
- Collections now play in release order instead of the order they were added to the library.

- First release as a Jellyfin plugin.
- Series view: the current season with previous episodes, and buttons to switch seasons.
- Click any episode to play it; playback continues into the following seasons.

name: Jellyfin True Music Library
description: Un seul onglet « Artistes », avec seulement les artistes principaux des albums, singles et EP, choisis d'après les fournisseurs de métadonnées. A single "Artists" tab, listing only the main artists of albums, singles and EPs, chosen from your metadata providers.
overview: Une médiathèque musicale sans artistes parasites. A music library without stray artists.

versions.changelog:
- Fixed (Jellyfin 12): "The instance of entity type 'People' cannot be tracked…" when a track also credits a composer, lyricist… whose name has an accented capital letter (e.g. "Érick Benzi"). The track was left unchanged. Run "Repair" again to fix the tracks that failed.
- New setting "Non-Latin names" (Japanese, Chinese, Korean, Cyrillic…): transliterated into Latin characters (as before), original script, or original script for a list of artists only.
- New setting "Order of the main artist sources": providers, tags and folder in the order you choose, e.g. tags first to trust your own album artist tags. Track credits still come from MusicBrainz whenever the album is identified there.
- Renamed "Jellyfin True Music Library", like the other k1k4k plugins.

- One "Artists" list with only the main artists of albums, singles and EPs, chosen from the library's metadata providers (MusicBrainz, TheAudioDB…), then the tags, then the artist folder. Collaborations show up under each artist; compilations and soundtracks under the folder artist.
- Featured artists stay credited on their tracks (`A;B`, `feat.`, `&`… are split), but no longer clutter the artist list nor the search. Their page stays reachable from their tracks.
- Analyze: a read-only report shows, for every album, the current and proposed artists, the source, the confidence and the disagreements. You can impose the main artists of an album by hand.
- Repair: applies the analysis after saving a snapshot. Stray entries such as `A;B` are removed, and artists are named the way MusicBrainz credits them most often.
- The library stays repaired: scans and "Replace all metadata" keep the decided artists, and new albums are resolved after each scan.
- Restore: puts everything back the way Jellyfin had it, and stops the plugin from fixing anything.
- Web interface: the duplicate "Album Artists" tab is hidden.
- No audio file is ever changed, and no metadata is locked. Back up Jellyfin before the first repair.
